docs.summary: Stack component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use Stack to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing.
Stack works well for arranging related content and creating responsive layouts. Use it to maintain visual consistency throughout your application.

anatomy.description: Stack is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistent spacing
bestPractices.description: Use uniform gaps and padding with stack.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Consider responsive behavior
bestPractices.description: Ensure stack adapts to different screen sizes.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore breakpoints
bestPractices.description: Fixed layouts can break on different devices.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest deeply
bestPractices.description: Avoid excessive nesting that complicates layout.
